title: Q-Shape - Quantitative Shape Analyzer
description: Q-Shape 1.6.0 is a stable software release for browser-based continuous shape measure calculations, with nonnegative scale and mirror-equivalent comparison, same-coordination-number rankings, 3D overlays, donor selection, batch analysis and report/CSV export. It includes four corrected Johnson reference coordinate sets from pinned primary Cosymlib data. The numerical implementation and reference library are unchanged from the archived rc.2 evaluation: 952 same-CN comparisons evaluated twice, 172 additional base fits under coordinate transformations, and 45 bounded high-CN fits. Scientific agreement is limited to the reported cases; broader external-holdout, cross-browser and independent-user qualification is not complete. CN20-CN60 results remain provisional outside the bounded tested cases. Cite the exact version and source commit used.
